# Viagogo Event Search & Ticket Listing Extractor

Viagogo is a ticket resale marketplace covering concerts, sports and theater events worldwide. This actor searches events by keyword, browses by city or category, or fetches full event pages with live ticket-listing prices, section and seat details.

## What this actor does

- Searches events by free-text keyword, paging through all matching results up to `maxItems`
- Browses events for one of 36 curated cities
- Browses events for one of 22 curated categories (sports, music genres, theater and more)
- Fetches full detail for specific event or search URLs, including ticket-type price groups and individual listing rows
- Filters results by country, active-listing availability and public-purchase eligibility
- Empty fields are omitted from records

## Output per event (search / browse)

- `eventId`, `title`, `sourceUrl`
- `venueName`, `venueId`, `venueCity`, `venueStateProvince`, `venueLocation`
- `countryCode`, `countryName`
- `dayOfWeek`, `formattedDate`, `formattedTime`, `formattedDateWithDayOfWeek`, `formattedRescheduledFromDate`
- `isTbd`, `isDateConfirmed`, `isTimeConfirmed`, `isMultidayEvent`, `eventStartTimestamp`
- `hasActiveListings`, `allowPublicPurchase`, `isParkingEvent`, `eventState`
- `recordType` — always `event`
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

## Output per event detail (mode=byUrl, event URLs)

All of the fields above where available, plus:

- `venueCountryCode`, `venueLatitude`, `venueLongitude`
- `totalListings`, `availableTickets`, `isPrimaryEvent`, `instantDeliveryAvailable`
- `ticketTypeGroups` — list of `{typeName, quantity, price, currency}`
- `listings` — list of `{row, seat, section, type, price, currency}`
- `eventDate`, `eventStartDateTime`, `eventTimeZone`

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | `search`, `browseByCity`, `browseByCategory` or `byUrl` |
| `searchQuery` | string | `taylor swift` | Free-text query (mode=search) |
| `city` | string | – | City to browse, from a curated list (mode=browseByCity) |
| `category` | string | – | Category to filter or browse (22 options) |
| `countryCode` | string | – | Only emit events in this ISO alpha-2 country, e.g. `US`, `GB` |
| `availableOnly` | boolean | `false` | Only emit events with active ticket listings |
| `publicPurchaseOnly` | boolean | `false` | Only emit events that allow public purchase |
| `startUrls` | array | `[]` | Viagogo event or search URLs (mode=byUrl) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–1000) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | off | Optional Apify proxy, used only as a fallback when a request is blocked |

### Example: search for an artist's events

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "coldplay",
  "countryCode": "GB",
  "availableOnly": true
}
```

### Example: browse events in a city

```json
{
  "mode": "browseByCity",
  "city": "new-york",
  "category": "musical"
}
```

### Example: browse a category

```json
{
  "mode": "browseByCategory",
  "category": "soccer"
}
```

### Example: fetch events by URL

```json
{
  "mode": "byUrl",
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.viagogo.com/E-161111256",
    "https://www.viagogo.com/search?q=taylor+swift"
  ]
}
```

## Use cases

- **Ticket market monitoring** — track which events currently have live resale listings
- **Venue and city analytics** — map event supply by venue, city and country
- **Event discovery feeds** — surface events by performer, city or category for a ticketing app
- **Availability alerts** — flag events with active listings and public purchase enabled
- **Cross-market research** — compare event inventory and pricing across regions

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with viagogo?** No. This is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by viagogo.

**Why do some events have no date fields?** Events marked TBD omit date-related fields entirely rather than returning empty strings.

**Why do search/browse records lack `ticketTypeGroups` and `listings`?** Those come from an event's own detail page; fetch the event's URL directly with `mode=byUrl` to get pricing and seat-level listing data.

**How fresh is the data?** Every run reads live search, browse and event pages at request time.

**Do I need an account to use this?** No. All event and listing data comes from publicly viewable pages.

**When is the proxy actually used?** Only as a fallback for requests that get blocked; most runs complete without needing it.

**Why might a specific event URL return nothing in `byUrl` mode?** Some individual event pages are occasionally inaccessible to anonymous requests; using a `/search` URL in the same mode is more reliable for discovering events.

**What does `hasActiveListings` tell me?** Whether the event currently has resale tickets listed on the marketplace, independent of whether `listings` detail was fetched.

**How many records can one run return?** Up to `maxItems`, capped at 1000 per run.
